description: Progressively refine one-line feedback into a Behavior Note, finalized PBC, and downstream derivation seeds without multiplying product artifacts.

agent.description: Normalizes feedback, writes artifacts, runs pressure passes, and records evidence.

product_owner.description: Answers the single highest-leverage clarification or patch decision when needed.

system.description: System effect adapter and administrative workflow authority

states.description: Raw one-line feedback has landed but has not yet been normalized into a Behavior Note.
Feedback is normalized into a Behavior Note; the agent decides whether one clarification is needed before drafting.
Blocked on the product owner answering the single highest-leverage clarification question.
A compact PBC has been drafted and is ready for a pressure pass.
A pressure pass is being run against the draft PBC to test it for readiness, needed patches, or vagueness.
Blocked on the product owner deciding whether to finalize with the pressure patch or send the PBC back for revision.
Terminal success: the final PBC is accepted and downstream work/test/design seeds can be derived.
Terminal disposal: the feedback was closed without a finalized PBC (won't fix, duplicate, unclear, or out of scope).

pressure_pass.description: The compact pressure pass verdict, tighten list, and patch.

disposition_decision.description: Reason this feedback is closed without a finalized PBC.

pbc.agent.base.v5.summary: Base instructions for agent-owned PBC refinement work.

pbc.product_owner.base.v5.summary: Base instructions for product-owner clarification and patch decisions.

agent.purpose: Normalize one-line feedback into a Behavior Note, draft a compact PBC, pressure-test it, and record typed evidence.
hardRules: Use wrkf next as the source of legal next actions.
Do not apply a transition unless its evidence and obligations are satisfied.
Record evidence before applying the transition that depends on it.
When blocked on product_owner, ask exactly one highest-leverage question or patch decision.
Do not mutate workflow state outside wrkf transition.apply.

product_owner.purpose: Answer clarification or patch decision obligations with minimal decisive input.
hardRules: Answer only the blocking decision requested by the workflow.
Prefer a crisp route or answer over broad redesign.
Do not mutate workflow state directly; provide evidence or obligation response.

open/intake.agentInstruction: Extract the raw feedback, normalize the signal, infer likely type, and identify the candidate highest-leverage clarification question.
avoid: writing a full PBC before the feedback is normalized

active/behavior_note.agentInstruction: Write or verify the Behavior Note, then decide whether one clarification is needed before drafting.

waiting/clarification.agentInstruction: Do not continue drafting. Wait for product_owner clarification_response or an authorized waiver.

active/pbc_draft.agentInstruction: Draft a compact PBC from current evidence and prepare it for pressure review.

active/pressure.agentInstruction: Run the pressure pass. Produce exactly one verdict: ready, needs_patch, or too_vague. Include tighten list and patch when applicable.
avoid: using a pressure pass from an old draft hash

waiting/patch_decision.agentInstruction: Do not revise or finalize until product_owner records patch_decision.route as finalize or revise.
avoid: choosing the route for the product owner

closed/finalized.agentInstruction: No further PBC refinement action is legal. Use the finalized PBC as downstream seed material.
avoid: reopening or mutating workflow state outside wrkf

closed/disposed.agentInstruction: No further PBC refinement action is legal. Preserve the disposition_decision as the closure rationale.
avoid: continuing to draft or pressure-test disposed feedback

normalize_feedback.prompt: Normalize raw feedback into intake_metadata. Capture original wording, normalized signal, likely type, uncertainty, and candidate clarification question.
normalize_feedback.operatorHint: Apply normalize_feedback only when revision and context are current.

ask_clarification.prompt: If clarification_needed is true, ask exactly one highest-leverage question. Make the question answerable in one short response.
ask_clarification.operatorHint: Apply ask_clarification to open the product_owner obligation.

draft_pbc.prompt: Draft the smallest useful PBC. Include behavior, preconditions, boundaries, acceptance signal, and known uncertainty. Do not expand into implementation design.
draft_pbc.operatorHint: Apply draft_pbc after clarification_needed=false is recorded.

answer_clarification.prompt: Record the product-owner answer or accepted default as clarification_response, satisfy the clarification_response obligation, then proceed to drafting.
answer_clarification.operatorHint: Apply answer_clarification only after the product_owner obligation is satisfied.

run_pressure_pass.prompt: Pressure-test the draft PBC against ambiguity, missing preconditions, overbreadth, unverifiable acceptance, and implementation leakage.
run_pressure_pass.operatorHint: Apply run_pressure_pass to enter the pressure phase.

finalize_ready_pbc.prompt: Only finalize if pressure_pass.verdict is ready and the pbc_final artifact is derived from the current draft.
finalize_ready_pbc.operatorHint: Apply finalize_ready_pbc only with a pressure_pass actor distinct from the pbc_draft actor.

request_patch_decision.prompt: Summarize the pressure patch and ask product_owner whether to finalize with patch or revise.
request_patch_decision.operatorHint: Apply request_patch_decision to open the product_owner patch_decision obligation.

revise_too_vague_pbc.prompt: Revise the PBC using the pressure pass. Preserve the behavioral contract; remove ambiguity before re-running pressure.
revise_too_vague_pbc.operatorHint: Apply revise_too_vague_pbc when pressure_pass.verdict is too_vague.

finalize_after_patch_decision.prompt: Finalize only if patch_decision.route is finalize, the obligation was satisfied by an authorized product_owner, and pbc_final reflects the accepted patch.
finalize_after_patch_decision.operatorHint: Apply finalize_after_patch_decision only with current revision/context and satisfied patch_decision obligation.

revise_after_patch_decision.prompt: Revise the draft according to patch_decision.route=revise. Cite the product-owner decision in the new draft evidence.
revise_after_patch_decision.operatorHint: Apply revise_after_patch_decision to return to pbc_draft.

dispose_from_behavior_note.prompt: Record disposition_decision before closing feedback from behavior_note without a PBC.
dispose_from_behavior_note.operatorHint: Apply dispose_from_behavior_note only when disposal is the intended terminal outcome.

dispose_from_pbc_draft.prompt: Record disposition_decision before closing feedback from pbc_draft without a finalized PBC.
dispose_from_pbc_draft.operatorHint: Apply dispose_from_pbc_draft only when disposal is the intended terminal outcome.

dispose_from_pressure.prompt: Record disposition_decision before closing feedback from pressure without patching or finalizing.
dispose_from_pressure.operatorHint: Apply dispose_from_pressure only when disposal is the intended terminal outcome.
